about: Part of the reference catalogue: designed experiments from chapters 2 to 11 and the glossary of Davies (ed.), The Design and Analysis
of Industrial Experiments, for testing that software reproduces them. source: the citation, with what was read and
when. experiments: each worked example with data (factors, responses, runs exactly as printed, in the printed
order), where it is printed, and expected: every number the book prints for it, as printed text (with a period
for the book's raised decimal point), with where it is printed (a page and a quotation) and check: how to
recompute it, or manual, the reason it is not recomputed. A check with a disagreement records a number known not
to reproduce and why, usually the book's own rounding. not_captured: what in these chapters is not an experiment
tests/test_reference_catalogue.py recomputes every number that has a check.
